name: University of Chester

facts.text: The University of Chester traces its history to 1839 and its main address is Parkgate Road, Chester, CH1 4BJ; it describes itself as 'a forward-thinking Modern University at the heart of a Historic City'.
Exton Park, the original Parkgate Road site that opened in 1839, is a 10-minute walk from Chester city centre and sits in the Garden Quarter, a student area with pubs, cafes and shops.
facts.sourceTitle: Exton Park, Chester | University of Chester

facts.text: Exton Park houses the Students' Union, catering outlets, the recently refurbished Seaborne Library with 24-hour access computer labs, fitness facilities and the university's central support services such as the Wellbeing and Mental Health team and the Careers team.
facts.sourceTitle: Exton Park, Chester | University of Chester

facts.text: Besides Chester, the university also has a site in Warrington (Remond House).

sources.title: Credibility Interviews | University of Chester
topics: their choice of university and course
sources.notes: Page describes the UKVI credibility interview, not a separate university pre-CAS interview. Quote: 'The main purpose of the interview is to assess whether you are a genuine student and whether the information you have provided in your application is accurate and credible.' Conducted by an Entry Clearance Officer in English, 'usually lasts between 30 and 60 minutes', 'most likely that you will be interviewed via video-call, however you also be interviewed in person or on the telephone'. 'Attendance is mandatory. If you are invited to an interview and do not attend without a valid reason, your visa application will be automatically refused.' Links to the Credibility Interview Preparation Guide PDF (below). No CAS Shield or Enroly mention.

sources.notes: PDF extracted with pypdf. The guide lists topic areas and 'Students should be prepared to discuss' bullets plus examples of strong/weak answers rather than verbatim questions; questionIds above are mapped from those bullets. The only verbatim question is the closing 'do you have anything to add?'. FAQ section: conducted by an Entry Clearance Officer after biometrics, in English, 'approximately 30 - 60 minutes', usually by video call; the interviewer's written record goes to the ECO who decides the visa; a second interview may be requested; the guide recommends requesting a transcript. Flags weak answers such as 'the UK has a good education system', 'good reputation', 'nice campus', 'I want a good job', and 'Relying solely on an agent'.

sources.title: University of Chester: live CAS Shield tenant (chester.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
